title: qa-tester return
description: The qa-tester's return object for one dispatch: one test case, or every test case in the ad-hoc full-run mode.

oneOf.description: Every assertion held and no part of the test was blocked; no file was written.

outcome.description: Every assertion held and no part of the test was blocked.

oneOf.description: The test produced at least one finding, of any severity; the QA review index and its per-finding files were written.

outcome.description: At least one finding, of any severity.

findings_file.description: The full path of the index written: qa_review_<iteration>_t<T>.md per single test, qa_review_<iteration>.md in the full-run mode.

must_fix_count.description: The number of Must Fix findings; 0 when only Should Fix or Nice to Have findings were written.

oneOf.description: No finding, and a part of the run was blocked for a reason confined to that test; no file was written and the caller continues the phase.

outcome.description: A test could not be driven for a reason confined to that test.

blocked_tests.description: One item per blocked test: one per single test, one per blocked test in the full-run mode.

cause.description: Why the test could not be driven, on one line.

oneOf.description: Nothing in the run can proceed; the caller halts.

outcome.description: Nothing in the run can proceed.

blocker.description: Why the run cannot proceed, on one line.
